key_reasoning.reason: StaleDatasourceService._delete_stale_indexes was rewritten into a lazy group-by-group walk (new _process_stale_group, _recheck_rows) that deletes Elasticsearch indexes irreversibly. It adds a re-select with guarded UPDATEs (lifecycle_state == STALE), a bounded walk (_RECHECK_BOUND_FACTOR * limit), per-group commits, and keep-index handling for re-check errors and rows changed mid-run. There is no exact precedent for the re-check-then-delete race handling. Write amplification and concurrency edge cases needed pinned tests.
